I am Shubham Singh Tomar. I'm a 3rd year student pursuing B.E in Chemical engineering. I am Interested in Machine learning and Data Science. I took Coursera's Computing for Data Analysis" course taught by Roger D. Peng. I think high-level languages like R and Python are great for prototyping models. I am excited to learning more of R and contribute towards its development. I would like to work on interactive data visualization project. I would really appreciate if mentors can help me get started.

messages.subject: Re: Introduction (New member to R foundation)
parts:
Hadley's ggvis, Ramanth's rCharts, and Simon's iPlots seem like the heavyweights in the field of interactive visualization now. Take a look at those projects and see if you can find an easy bug/feature to fix. 

I think it will be a few more weeks until there is an official list of project ideas & mentors but contributing to any of those projects would be a very strong point in an application. 

Michael
